items.name: A dozen new projects brought on-line in 2025
items.claim: Per CNOOC's 2025 annual results release, the Company brought on-line a dozen new projects in 2025 and continued to improve the producing reserves ratio and recovery rate of its producing oilfields.
items.source_excerpt: In 2025, the Company brought on-line a dozen of new projects, and continued to improve the producing reserves ratio and the recovery rate of the producing oilfields.

items.name: 4 new exploration projects acquired in Iraq, Kazakhstan and Indonesia
items.claim: The Company acquired 4 new exploration projects in Iraq, Kazakhstan and Indonesia, further diversifying the overseas asset portfolio.
items.source_excerpt: In addition, the Company acquired 4 new exploration projects in Iraq, Kazakhstan and Indonesia, further diversifying the overseas asset portfolio.

items.name: Hainan CZ7 Offshore Wind Power Project and world's first 16-MW tension-leg floating wind platform, under construction
items.claim: Hainan CZ7 Offshore Wind Power Project and the world's first 16-MW tension-leg floating wind power platform had started construction.
items.source_excerpt: Hainan CZ7 Offshore Wind Power Project and the world's first 16-MW tension-leg floating wind power platform had started construction.

items.name: China's first offshore CCUS demonstration project at Enping 15-1 Oilfield, put into operation
items.claim: Per CNOOC's annual results release, China's first offshore CCUS demonstration project, at the Enping 15-1 Oilfield, was successfully brought into operation.
items.source_excerpt: China's first offshore CCUS demonstration project at Enping 15-1 Oilfield was successfully put into operation.

notes: 2025 annual-results release (stored, HTTP 200) discloses project pipeline items across CNOOC's China and overseas portfolio; none names Arctic LNG 2 specifically (the arctic-sea-route mapping's russian-arctic-lng-export evidence for CNOOC's 10% stake is a 2019 Mitsui release, not fetched to data/web). No RPO/backlog figure is disclosed in this release; CNOOC discloses oil and gas reserves and production, not an order backlog in the pipeline sense.
